newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The government is expected to issue a decree to compensate the workers sacked following restructuring.
* Parliament will debate in joint session the 1997 state budget.

* The European Union will encourage Romania's efforts during the transition period to achieve a social market economy, said European Commission President Jacques Santer at the end of his visit to Bucharest.

* Romania and Hungary support each other in their bid to join NATO as they are partners and not contenders, said Foreign Minister Adrian Severin after meeting the head of the foreign policy commision of Hungarian parliament. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
